notes: ABox revision on a functional relation (orbits): the Moon orbits Mars. Every model holds the Moon's planet in every language. The subject is "the Moon" in all queries. The one related question asks whether Earth has a natural satellite (inverse, yes before, no after); caveat: its chain rests on functionality plus a closed-world "only satellite" step that the edit itself overturns. Derived: the atmosphere of the planet the Moon orbits, the planet orbited by the body the Apollo 11 astronauts walked on (binding), and whether Phobos and the Moon share a planet. The indeterminate query asks which planet always sees the same face of the Moon (a background-belief case: the tidal-locking fact may be stored under Earth's name or under the description the edit changed). Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
